# oxide_current_user (Data Source)

Retrieve information about the currently authenticated user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_current_user" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name that identifies the user.
- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the user.
- `silo_id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the silo to which the user belongs.
- `silo_name` (String) Name of the silo to which the user belongs.
- `time_created` (String) Timestamp of when the user was created.
- `time_modified` (String) Timestamp of when the user was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
